title: {Syn} Scaling Laws Made Model Growth Predictable
content:
Neural scaling laws describe regular relationships between model performance, data, parameters, and compute. They helped make large training runs less like guesswork.

The practical impact is planning: if a curve is reliable, teams can forecast whether more data, a larger model, or more compute is likely to help.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
